Title: Duplicate reference designator 'C1' detected (2 instances).
Explanation: Multiple components share reference 'C1' at positions: (110.0, 50.0), (120.0, 50.0). This causes netlist mapping collisions and manufacturing halts.
Remediation: Re-annotate the schematic uniquely and update the PCB.

Title: Component 'D1' has missing or placeholder value ('~').
Explanation: Components must carry meaningful nominal values (e.g. '10k', '100nF', 'LM358') to enable automated Bill of Materials generation and procurement.
Remediation: Assign a valid component value for 'D1' in the schematic.

Title: Component 'U2' has no footprint assigned.
Explanation: Components without valid footprints cannot be placed or manufactured on the PCB.
Remediation: Assign a footprint from the KiCad Footprint Library for 'U2'.

Title: Component 'R?' is unannotated or contains wildcard placeholder characters.
Explanation: References like 'R?' or 'REF**' indicate that schematic annotation was bypassed before updating the board.
Remediation: Run Tools > Annotate Schematic in the schematic editor and update the PCB.

Title: Net 'DANG_NET' is connected to only 1 pad (R? pin 2).
Explanation: A net with only one connection cannot form a closed electrical circuit. In high-frequency designs, dangling stubs act as quarter-wave resonant antennas radiating EMI.
Remediation: Verify if net 'DANG_NET' is missing a destination pin in the schematic or delete the dangling net label.

Title: Net 'EMPTY_NET' has 0 assigned pads.
Explanation: The net is declared in the PCB netlist but no component pads are connected to it. This typically occurs after deleting components without cleaning up nets.
Remediation: Perform Tools > Update PCB from Schematic to remove unused net declarations.

Title: Pad 3 of 'Q1' has no net assignment.
Explanation: Electrical pad 3 on 'Q1' is unassigned. If this pin is an active signal or supply pin, it is currently disconnected.
Remediation: Verify schematic connections for 'Q1' pin 3 or explicitly place a No-Connect (NC) flag in the schematic.

Title: No board outline detected on Edge.Cuts layer.
Explanation: A PCB must have a closed continuous boundary drawn on the Edge.Cuts layer. Without it, board dimensions cannot be calculated and CAM milling machines cannot route the board outline.
Remediation: Select the Edge.Cuts layer in KiCad and draw a closed rectangular or polygon boundary around your layout.

Title: Board has 6 components placed but 0 copper tracks routed.
Explanation: The PCB layout appears to be in early placement stage with no copper tracks routed yet.
Remediation: Route nets using Route > Single Track (X) in KiCad PCB Editor.
